description: Verify two scientific claims against real abstracts: one is supported, one is contradicted, and one paper is unrelated. Cite the evidence for each verdict.
task_prompt:
Two claims are under review.
Claim 1: ALDH1 expression is associated with better breast cancer outcomes.
Claim 2: Birth-weight is positively associated with breast cancer.
Using the papers in documents/, decide for each claim whether the evidence supports it, contradicts it, or does not give enough information to decide. Write each verdict on its own line as 'Claim N: SUPPORTED', 'Claim N: CONTRADICTED' or 'Claim N: NOT ENOUGH INFO'. For each verdict, cite the paper and the specific result behind it.

seeds.text: Birth-weight is positively associated with breast cancer.
rationale: The majority of studies identified a positive link between birthweight and premenopausal, but not postmenopausal, breast cancer.

The relative risk estimate for breast cancer comparing women with high birthweight to women with low birthweight combining all studies including both pre- and postmenopausal breast cancer was 1.23 (95% confidence interval 1.13-1.34).

seeds.text: ALDH1 expression is associated with better breast cancer outcomes.
rationale: In a series of 577 breast carcinomas, expression of ALDH1 detected by immunostaining correlated with poor prognosis.

claim_2_verdict.description: Claim 2 is supported by the evidence
claim_2_verdict.claim: Birth-weight is positively associated with breast cancer.

claim_1_verdict.description: Claim 1 is contradicted by the evidence
claim_1_verdict.claim: ALDH1 expression is associated with better breast cancer outcomes.

paper_b_result.description: Cites the key result from Paper B (1.23, 1.13)

paper_a_result.description: Cites the key result from Paper A (577)

claim_1_flipped.description: Claim 1 called supported, but Paper A contradicts it

claim_2_flipped.description: Claim 2 called contradicted, but Paper B supports it
